vetted_request.title: Vetted User Invitation Request
vetted_request.description: Represents an invitation request from an aspiring vetted user to obtain access credentials and password links.

affiliation.description: Professional or community affiliation (e.g., Citi SRE, FIRST Alumni, PTK Scholar).

message.description: Optional statement detailing the reason or background for seeking vetting.

linkSent.description: Indicates whether the secure password link has been dispatched to the user.

investment_pod.title: Investment Pod
investment_pod.description: Represents a collective investment pod/club with portfolio holdings and trade proposals.

description.description: Detailed description of the pod's goals.

focus.description: Target sector focus of the pod.

isUserMember.description: Whether the current user is a member.

proposals.description: List of active or closed trade proposals.

/vetted_requests/{requestId}.description: Collection of secure vetted profile invitation requests.

/pods/{podId}.description: Collection of community investment pods with real-time portfolio tracking and proposals.
